# PostgreSQL

A bot using **PostgreSQL** and TypeScript for relational data storage.

<Cards>
  <Card href="https://www.postgresql.org/" title="PostgreSQL" description="Relational database." />
  <Card href="/docs/discord-bots" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-bots/postgres-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Configure PostgreSQL connection in `.env`:

```bash
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mybot
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- PostgreSQL integration
- Connection pooling
- TypeScript support
- SQL query building

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
